scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.ios:staging: APP_ENV=staging node scripts/gen-env.js && xcodebuild -workspace ios/KwalaMobile.xcworkspace -scheme KwalaMobile -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/build/staging EXPO_CHANNEL=staging PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER=com.kwalaintel.mobile.staging build
scripts.ios:production: APP_ENV=production node scripts/gen-env.js && xcodebuild -workspace ios/KwalaMobile.xcworkspace -scheme KwalaMobile -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/build/production EXPO_CHANNEL=production build
scripts.android:staging: APP_ENV=staging node scripts/gen-env.js && cd android && ./gradlew assembleStagingRelease
scripts.android:production: APP_ENV=production node scripts/gen-env.js && cd android && ./gradlew assembleProductionRelease
scripts.runtime:check: npx expo-updates runtimeversion:resolve --platform ios --workflow generic && npx expo-updates runtimeversion:resolve --platform android --workflow generic
